newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow customs seize crocodiles, monkeys.
newsitem.headline: Moscow customs seize crocodiles, monkeys.

text.p: Customs officials seized a mysterious delivery of nine baby crocodiles, 20 monkeys and 119 parrots at Moscow's main international airport on Friday, Itar-Tass news agency said.

Tass quoted customs officials as saying the birds and animals, drugged and loaded into wooden crates, had arrived at Sheremetevo airport on a flight from an African country without any documents identifying their destination.
One parrot had already died and veterinary surgeons said some of the parrots and monkeys would probably not wake up from their drug-induced sleep.
Tass said the animals would be put into quarantine while their fate was decided. Exotic birds and animals have become increasingly common pets in the new Russia.
